description: Ministry of Labour and Foreign Employment - The Collective agreement between Habib Bank Limited Colombo 11 and other part Ceylon Bank Employees Union Colombo 10 - The Collective agreement between Keels Food Products PLC, Colombo 2 and other part Ceylon Mercantile Industrial and General Worker's Union Colombo 03 (E only)
reasoning: This gazette content publishes a Collective Agreement between a bank and a trade union under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains detailed regulatory terms and conditions of employment, including salary revisions, allowances, and employment conditions. This falls under legal/regulatory matters as it involves the formal publication of a legally binding agreement under statutory authority, specifically referencing the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131.
